resources.string: Derive the palette from your wallpaper (Android 12+)

Render the entire app through a color-vision filter — experience your own UI as other people do. Approximate sRGB preview (Android 12+); the Vision tab runs the precise Machado model on individual colors.

Chromatic teaches color theory by doing: lessons, a harmony wheel, WCAG and APCA contrast tooling, tonal palettes, perceptual gradient blending, and vision simulations — all powered by a fully unit-tested color engine.
Fully offline — no data ever leaves your device unless you choose to share it.
No crash reports. If the app ever closes unexpectedly, the details will be collected here — nothing is sent anywhere unless you share it.

Do I need an account? No — Chromatic has no accounts and no network access.
Where are my palettes stored? Only on this device, in the app\'s private storage, included in Android backups.
Why is there no internet permission? By design: the app cannot go online, so your colors never leave your device.
